owner_directive: Run related test categories together in public-facing test suites; two to four categories per coherent batch (e.g. map + roundabout + GPS), reducing duplicate test runs/APK builds while reporting each checklist item independently.

visibility.test_contracts: public GitHub repository, including source-backed expected outcomes, safe fixtures, non-secret test harnesses and sanitized results
visibility.app_source: private combined application in phuk-prog/drivemate-app; relevant individual components and necessary test dependencies may be public
visibility.app_integrated_execution: All tests execute in public testing repositories on the real selected component code; no private batch testing. Combined-app assembly and final APK generation stay private.
visibility.credentials: No TomTom API key, signing material, access tokens, private journeys, or identifiable location logs in public repositories or artifacts
visibility.external_reference_rule: Expected road layout and legality derive from independent official UK sources and corroborated externally sourced road data, not copied DriveMate outputs or simulated competitor claims

grouped_execution.selection_rule: Choose 2, 3, or 4 logically related categories; prefer a single coherent workflow/build instead of separate APKs. The full group need not be run if smaller subset suffices. A one-category run remains permitted for targeted failure isolation.
grouped_execution.reporting_rule: For every category and checklist ID: report independently its baseline, source truth, tests, failures, after-fix result, provenance and unknowns. Show combined batch results only in addition.
grouped_execution.acceptance_rule: Batch fails if any mandatory relevant test is missing, skipped or failed; verified-illegal manoeuvres always block release. A passing simulation never establishes UK-road truth or real API integration.
grouped_execution.release_rule: Test binaries are not released or published merely to run tests. Any APK output requires the mandatory automated/replay/navigation-robot release gates; keep production app private and release nothing while failing or unverified.
grouped_execution.ci_rule: Run coherent public CI jobs on exact identified component and test revisions; no private test checkout. Only combined-app assembly/final APK generation is private. Keep separate per-category and checklist-item provenance.

batches.title: Roundabouts, maps and positioning
batches.scope: GPS/map matching, the correct carriageway, roundabout lane guidance and legal routing/rerouting
batches.example_test_case: At a Greater Manchester roundabout, compare externally verified road geometry and legal signs with GPS matching, drawn route, lane advice and route legality

batches.title: On-road guidance and alerts
batches.scope: Turn cards, live traffic and road hazards, limits/signals/camera warnings and Android Auto projection
batches.example_test_case: At a verified junction, display the correct next turn, road alerts and guidance on phone and Android Auto

batches.title: Plan, search, stop and arrive
batches.scope: Search, multiple stops, arrival-point handling and first-time trip help
batches.example_test_case: Find a UK property, build a legal multi-stop trip and end at an externally checked vehicle-accessible arrival point

batches.title: Interaction, accessibility and privacy
batches.scope: Audio guidance, controls/accessibility, personal data and incident-report privacy
batches.example_test_case: Speak a complex instruction while Bluetooth music ducks and sensitive journey data is kept local

batches.title: Offline map packages and downloads
batches.scope: UK offline map availability, updates, storage, download progress and recovery
batches.example_test_case: Download compatible Greater Manchester region, verify hashes and then test offline routing and map render with interrupted update

boundaries: The word public refers to public test contracts/fixtures/standards and sanitized evidence. Do not publicly publish an APK or the closed-source app as a shortcut to making its tests public. No true combined run is claimed until executed and checked.
